blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
blocks.zh: 鉴于一组LEGO部件和一个集合对象的图像,我们的任务是推断每个部分的姿势来组装对象. 与传统的立体重建不同,这样做需要满足离散的物理制约,这提供了结构,但使问题组合起来,并对小的构成错误高度敏感。 为了了解各部分如何组合在一起的先验情况,我们在程序生成的组件上培训一个固定条件的SE(3)流动模型。 然后我们微调这个模型注入图像调制, 使用1%的数据。 然而,虽然知识流抓住了全球结构,但它并没有强制实施互联互通。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个分析连接域指导,在测试时对连接的组件进行预测。 通过这种方式,我们用模型大小、预训和指导来展示建筑质量的提高。 我们在https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/网站上提供我们的模型和数据供研究之用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Imagine opening a new set of LEGO to find a box full of pieces, but no instructions.
All you have is the picture on the front of the box.
You can identify a number of parts visible on the surface, but the image only reveals the outside.
The internal structure must be inferred: which bricks support which, what fills the spaces you cannot see.
Every piece must end up with a precise position and orientation satisfying discrete connector-defined constraints.
This is the problem we address: given an inventory of parts and a single image of the completed assembly, recover the 6D pose of each piece (see Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
想象一下,打开一套新的LEGO来寻找一个装满碎片的盒子,但没有指令.
你只有盒子前方的图片
您可以识别一些表面可见的部分,但图像只揭示外部.
内部结构必须推断:哪个砖块支持哪个,什么填充你看不到的空格。
每一块最终必须有一个精确的位置和方向,满足离散连接器定义的限制。
这就是我们所处理的问题:如果对部件进行清点,并对完成的组装进行单一的图像,则回收每块的6D姿势(见图1)。

blocks.en:
While sharing some of the ambiguities of traditional monocular 3D reconstruction – such as from occlusion – the task presents unique challenges.
Though it is possible to computationally verify the validity of a given assembly, figuring out how to go from parts to structure requires understanding not just how pieces fit together, but how they fit together jointly, over possibly many at once.
Contributing to this complexity, our assembly domain spans thousands of parts which connect in diverse ways.
blocks.zh:
虽然与传统单一立体重建的一些模糊之处相同,例如隐居,但这项任务提出了独特的挑战。
虽然可以计算验证一个特定组装的有效性,但要确定如何从部件走向结构,不仅需要了解各个部件如何组合在一起,而且需要了解它们如何组合在一起,可能同时有许多部件。
造成这种复杂性的原因是,我们的组装领域跨越数千个以不同方式相互连接的部分。

blocks.en:
We address this by learning a partset-conditioned generative assembly prior.
To obtain sufficient supervision, we generate large-scale procedural structure data using a typed connector system ( Kulits and Schmid, 2026 ) defined over LDraw ( Jessiman, 1995–2026 ) parts, starting from randomly sampled pieces and iteratively placing new ones through compatible connectors.
We use these to train an S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) flow model that takes an unordered inventory together with noisy poses and removes noise.
blocks.zh:
我们通过先学习一个部分设定的基因组装来解决这个问题。
为了获得足够的监督,我们利用一个在LDraw(Jessiman,1995–2026)部件上定义的打字连接器系统(Kulits和Schmid,2026)生成大规模的程序结构数据,从随机抽取的棋子开始,并通过兼容的连接器迭代放置新的棋子.
我们用这些来训练一种S E (3) SE (3) 的流线模型,它把一个无序的盘点与吵闹的姿势并去除噪音.

blocks.en:
The purpose of this stage is not to understand object semantics, but to learn the geometry of assembly: which parts can connect, how they tend to align, and how local connections compose into global structure.
Rather than being human-designed or semantically meaningful, these assemblies provide constraint-rich samples from the physical grammar of LEGO assembly.
Pretraining on this data amortizes search over connector-valid configurations into a reusable prior on assembly and structure.
blocks.zh:
这个阶段的目的不是理解对象语义,而是学习组装的几何:哪些部分可以连接,它们倾向于如何对齐,局部连接如何组成全球结构.
这些组装不是由人类设计或有目的的,而是从LEGO组装的物理语法中提供了制约性丰富的样本。
此数据的预训将连接器- 验证配置的搜索分期进行, 在组装和结构上进行再使用 。

blocks.en:
We then adapt the assembly prior to perform partset-conditioned visual reconstruction.
For this, we render a smaller set of procedural assemblies to create structure–image pairs.
From the images, we extract features from a frozen visual encoder and finetune the flow model with injected cross-attention.
blocks.zh:
然后我们先调整组装 然后再进行部分配置的视觉重建
为此,我们制造了一套较小的程序大会来创建结构-图像对。
从图像中,我们从一个冷冻的视觉编码器中提取特征,并用注入的交叉注意来微调流模型.

blocks.en:
Although pretraining captures useful global assembly structure, learned predictions alone do not guarantee precise connectivity.
Small translational and rotational errors can leave intended connections slightly misaligned.
To address this, we introduce connectivity-field guidance, an analytic test-time energy defined over poses and connector geometry.
The field is zero on exactly connected assemblies, and its gradient pulls predictions toward connected structure.
Following diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) ( Chung et al., 2023 ) , we condition on connectedness with the field as the negative log-likelihood, correcting poses in late steps along its gradient at the model’s predicted final assembly.
blocks.zh:
虽然预训能捕捉有用的全球组装结构,但光是学到的预测并不能保证精确的连通性.
小的翻译错误和旋转错误可能会使预期的连接略微错位.
为了解决这个问题,我们引入了连接-场指导,一种分析测试时能量,在姿势和连接器几何上定义.
完全相连的组件上场数为零,它的梯度将预测引向相连的结构.
在扩散后取样(DPS)(Chung等人,2023年)之后,我们以与现场的关联性为条件,因为负对数的相似性,在模型预测的最后组装时,纠正沿梯度的后期步骤。

blocks.en:
We evaluate our model on both inventory-conditioned assembly and image-conditioned reconstruction.
Beyond pose accuracy, we evaluate assembly and connection validity.
We demonstrate that assembly pretraining improves structural understanding, that task performance scales with model capacity, and that connectivity-field guidance improves the validity of assemblies when applied at inference time.
blocks.zh:
我们评价我们的模型,既包括库存的装配,也包括图像的重建。
除了精确外,我们评价组装和连接的有效性。
我们表明,装配预训提高了对结构的理解,具有示范能力的任务性能尺度,而且互联互通实地指导在推论时间应用时提高了装配的有效性。

blocks.en: Our core contributions are as follows: 1. We train a set-conditioned S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated LEGO assemblies to learn an adaptable assembly prior 2. We adapt this prior to single-image reconstruction using a fraction the amount of data 3. We introduce connectivity-field guidance, an analytic energy that injects known connector structure at test time, pulling predictions toward connected assemblies without retraining

blocks.zh: 在程序生成的LEGO组件上,我们训练一个SE(3)SE(3)流程模型,以事先学习一个可适应的组件

blocks.zh: 在进行单像重建之前,我们用一小部分的数据来调整它

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Brick Assembly. Prior work on brick assembly has addressed several specific subproblems.
Legolization methods convert target geometry into brick layouts on discrete grids ( Luo et al., 2015 ; Lennon et al., 2021 ) .
BrickGPT ( Pun et al., 2025 ) finetunes a language model to autoregressively place bricks, but predicts voxel positions over a small block vocabulary; LEGO-Maker ( Ge et al., 2025 ) creates LEGO models from an image over a similarly restricted part set.
For reconstruction, Tattersall et al. (2020) recover LEGO models from 24 calibrated views via space carving and cuboid fitting, but handle only four rectangular brick types; Wang et al. (2022) infer per-step brick poses from instruction manuals but address sequential single-part placement rather than joint assembly.
BrickNet ( Kulits and Schmid, 2026 ) introduce a typed connector system and graph-based generation over the full LDraw part library and finetune a language model to autoregressively produce brick structures from text.
Each step places a part through a connection to the existing structure, so its outputs are connected by construction, and it takes no image or inventory.
BrickBench ( Kulits et al., 2026 ) evaluates coding agents on text-conditioned design of buildable assemblies with up to 4000 parts using the same library and tests them under different constraints.
Apart from the per-step placement of Wang et al. (2022) , these methods choose which parts to use, and none is provided a fixed set of parts.
Providing an inventory constrains the structure without determining it, as the same parts can build many assemblies.
As it must be used exactly, a model cannot omit a part that does not fit and must connect every part.
No prior work addresses inventory-conditioned assembly or reconstruction over the full part library.
blocks.zh:
砖大会. 先前关于砖块组装的工作已涉及几个具体问题。
乐高化方法将目标几何转换成离散网格上的砖块布局(Luo等人,2015年;Lennon等人,2021年).
BrickGPT(Pun等人,2025年)对一种语言模型进行微调,以自动地放置砖块,但预测小块词汇上的voxel位置;LEGO-Maker(Ge等人,2025年)从一个图像上创建了LEGO模型,以覆盖一个类似限制的部分集.
为了重建,Tattersall等人(2020年)通过空间雕刻和立方体装配,从24个校准视图中回收LEGO模型,但只处理4种矩形砖型; Wang等人. (2022年)推断每步砖从教学手册中抽出,但涉及顺序单段布置,而不是联合组装.
BrickNet(Kulits和Schmid,2026年)在全LDraw部分库上引入了打字连接器系统和基于图形的生成,并微调了一种语言模型,从文本中自动生成砖结构.
每个步骤都会通过连接到现有结构来放置一部分,因此其产出是通过构建来连接的,不需要图像或盘点.
Brick Bench(Kulits等人,2026年)利用同一库对可建组件的文本条件设计进行编码剂评价,并在不同的限制下进行测试。
除了王等人(2022年)的逐步投放外,这些方法选择使用哪些部件,没有固定的部件集.
提供清单会限制结构,而不确定,因为同样的部分可以建造许多组件。
由于必须准确使用,一个模型不能省略一个不适合并且必须连接每个部分的部分。
以前的工作没有涉及整个图书馆的库存装配或重建。

blocks.en:
3D Part Assembly. Generative part assembly methods predict rigid poses for a set of parts to form a complete object ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2020 ) , with recent work using score-based ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) , diffusion ( Scarpellini et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , hierarchical ( Du et al., 2024 ) , and flow-based ( Li et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) formulations.
GARF ( Li et al., 2025 ) and Rectified Point Flow ( Sun et al., 2025 ) are 3D-only, though Assembler ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) is additionally image-conditioned.
While these are architecturally similar (we employ a standard DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) ), they differ in task, and are designed for arbitrary geometry encoded as sampled points.
blocks.zh:
三维 部分大会。 基因组部分组装方法预测一组部分的刚性姿势形成完整的物体(黄等人,2020年;李等人,2020年),近期工作采用分数法(程等人,2023年),扩散. (Scarpellini等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年),等级 (Du等人,2024年),和流基(Li等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年)配方.
GARF(Li等人,2025年)和校正点流(Sun等人,2025年)只有3D级,不过Assembler(Zhao等人,2025年)还有图像条件.
虽然这些在建筑学上是相似的(我们使用一个标准的DiT(Peebles and Xie, 2023)),但它们在任务上是不同的,并被设计为任意几何编码为样本点.

blocks.en:
SE(3) Flow Matching and Guided Sampling. The flow matching paradigm ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) has been extended to S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) for protein structure generation ( Bose et al., 2024 ; Yim et al., 2023 ; Campbell et al., 2024 ) , where, as in our setting, structures are built from a fixed vocabulary of units rather than arbitrary parts.
Diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) ( Chung et al., 2023 ) corrects each denoising step using gradients of a measurement likelihood; classifier ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) and classifier-free ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) guidance follow the same principle with learned signals.
Our connectivity-field guidance applies the DPS correction with an analytic energy over known connector geometry as the negative log-likelihood.
No prior work integrates connectivity differentiably as test-time guidance in an assembly task.
blocks.zh:
SE(3)流量匹配和引导采样. 流量匹配范式(Lipman等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年)已扩展至SE(3)SE(3),用于蛋白质结构生成(Bose等人,2024年;Yim等人,2023年;Campbell等人,2024年),与我们所处的环境一样,其结构是根据固定的单位词汇而不是任意的部分构建的.
消散后采样(DPS)(Chung等人,2023年)利用测量概率的梯度来校正每个去诺步骤;分类器(Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021年)和无分类器(Ho and Salimans, 2021年)遵循同样的原理,并带有学到的信号.
我们的互联互通场指导应用了DPS校正,分析能量比已知的连接器几何为负对数。
以前的工作没有将连通性作为测试时间指导不同地纳入组装任务。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.1 建模

blocks.en:
We represent LEGO assemblies using the LDraw ( Jessiman, 1995–2026 ) modeling system, which consists of digital replicas of thousands of parts.
In LDraw, a model is defined by a set of piece instances, each having type, material, and S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) pose.
It does not directly model part connectivity, for which we employ the BrickNet ( Kulits and Schmid, 2026 ) typed connector system, an annotation layer of local connector frames over LDraw parts which defines how pieces connect to one another.
These connection interfaces include stud–hole, hinge, axle, ball joint, and fixed connectors, each defining a family of allowed relative transforms between two parts.
Stud-type connectors, for instance, allow for one degree of rotational freedom about an interface.
Given an LDraw assembly, BrickNet parses posed parts into a graph where structure is defined by pieces as nodes and edges of connectivity.
In this work, we use LDraw as the source of part geometry, while the BrickNet connector system is used to evaluate the validity of an assembly and integral to the production of procedural training data.
blocks.zh:
我们代表LEGO大会使用LDraw(Jessiman,1995–2026)建模系统,该系统由数千个部件的数字复制件组成.
在LDraw中,一个模型由一组片段实例定义,每个实例都有类型,材料,以及S E (3 ) SE (3) 姿势.
它并不直接模拟部分连接,我们为此采用了BrickNet(Kulits and Schmid, 2026)的打字连接器系统,这是一个本地连接器框架在LDraw部分之上的注释层,它定义了片段如何相互连接.
这些连接接口包括螺旋孔、链、轴、球关节和固定连接器,每个连接器都定义了两个部分之间允许的相对变换的家族。
例如, Stud-type 连接器允许对接口有一定程度的旋转自由。
鉴于LDraw组装,BrickNet parses将部分投放到一个图中,其中结构被片段定义为连接的节点和边缘.
在这部作品中,我们使用LDraw作为部分几何的源头,而BrickNet连接器系统则用于评价一个组装的有效性以及生产程序训练数据所不可或缺的内容.

blocks.en: 3.2 ProcBrick
blocks.zh: 3.2 普罗克砖

blocks.en:
To train our assembly prior, we introduce ProcBrick, a procedural generator of LEGO assemblies, and use it to synthesize a dataset of 100 million structures of 100 parts each.
Parts are drawn from 6,339 geometry classes, which we use to group LDraw parts with identical colliders and connector interfaces.
Starting with a random seed piece, we iteratively append pieces onto the structure.
Rather than sample naively in space, we attempt placements at random compatible connector sites and reject those that collide.
However, naive rejection sampling favors sparse assemblies: placements that extend into open space rarely collide, while those among existing parts, where further connections would form, do so more frequently.
We instead stochastically accept collision-free placements to favor dense packing and, for each new part, numbers of connector joins and connected neighbors within the range of human-designed models, so that assemblies are compact and multiply connected.
As sampling is autoregressive, each sequence prefix defines a valid structure and lengths can be varied in pretraining.
For image-conditioned finetuning, we generate an additional one million ProcBrick structures, 1% as many as for pretraining, and render them with Blender.
Rather than consistently include 100 parts, we balance counts between 2 and 100.
For rendering, each part is assigned a printed or plain variant of its geometry class and a material, giving 12,663 distinct parts.
We fit part and material frequencies to human-designed models (see App. H ).
See Fig. 2 for render samples.
Although the procedural assemblies are not individually realistic as sets a human might construct, our intent is not to model semantics but to span the space of valid structure to achieve broad support.
blocks.zh:
为了提前训练我们的组装,我们引入了ProcBrick,一个LEGO组装的程序生成器,并用它合成一个包含1亿个结构的数据集,每组100个部件.
部件从6,339个几何类中抽取,我们用这些类组 LDraw 部件具有相同的对撞器和连接器接口.
从随机种子开始,我们迭代地将棋子附在结构上。
我们并非天真地在太空中取样,而是试图在随机相容的连接器站点放置,并拒绝碰撞的连接器站点。
然而,天真的拒绝抽样有利于稀疏的组件:进入开放空间的装置很少发生碰撞,而那些在现有部分之间形成进一步联系的装置则更经常发生碰撞。
相反,我们严格地接受没有碰撞的放置,以有利于密集的包装,对于每一个新的部分,连接器的数量在人类设计的模型范围内加入和连接的邻居,这样,组件就变得紧凑和成倍相连。
由于采样具有自动递归性,每个序列前缀都定义了有效的结构,长度可以在预训中变化.
对于图像条件化的微调,我们再生成100万个ProcBrick结构,比预训多1%,并用Blender制成.
我们并非一贯地包括100个部分,而是在2至100个部分之间取得平衡。
对于渲染,每个部分都被分配到其几何类的印刷或平面变体和一个材料,给出了12,663个不同的部分.
我们把部分和材料频率与人类设计的模型相匹配(见App.H.)。
见法果. 2 用于制成样品。
虽然程序性集会不象人的能力所构建的设定那样单独现实,但我们的意图不是模拟语义,而是跨越有效结构的空间,以获得广泛支持。

blocks.en: 3.3 Problem
blocks.zh: 3.3 问题

blocks.en:
We formulate our task as 6-DoF pose prediction over an unordered multiset of known rigid parts: 𝒫 = { ( p i , m i ) } i = 1 N , \mathcal{P}=\{(p_{i},m_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N}, (1) where p i p_{i} denotes the part type and m i m_{i} is the material.
The goal is to predict one transform per part, X = { T i } i = 1 N , T i ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) , X=\{T_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N},\qquad T_{i}\in SE(3), (2) such that the transformed parts form the object depicted in a provided image I I .
Poses are predicted with the assembly centered at its mass-weighted centroid but in an arbitrary global orientation, so we evaluate up to a global rigid transform.
As the inventory may contain duplicate parts, we do not fix ordering.
Parts may have rotational symmetries.
Training and evaluation therefore account for these three equivalences: global rigid transform, duplicate-part permutation, and intrinsic part symmetry.
blocks.zh:
我们以6-DoF的形式提出对已知僵硬部分的无序多集的预测:P={(pi,mi)}i=1N,\mathcal{(p_{i)},m_{i}=1}^{N}, (1)p i _{i}表示部分类型,m i m_{i}是材料。

We use a standard diffusion-transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) backbone without S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) -equivariant layers ( Fig. 3 ).
Prior work on S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) flow matching for proteins ( Yim et al., 2024 ) uses invariant point attention (IPA) layers from AlphaFold 2 ( Jumper et al., 2021 ) , but with data augmentation, non-equivariant models can match the data efficiency of equivariant ones given sufficient training ( Brehmer et al., 2025 ) ; AlphaFold 3 ( Abramson et al., 2024 ) achieves strong results with a non-equivariant architecture and data augmentation, which we follow.
Each input token represents a part: the token embedding is the sum of a learned part-type embedding, linear encodings of the current pose, and optionally a learned material embedding.
As the input is unordered, no positional encoding is used.
In the reconstruction experiment, we inject image conditioning through decoupled cross-attention ( Ye et al., 2023 ) in each of the DiT blocks from part tokens to frozen DINOv3-L ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) features (CLS and patch tokens) from layer 18 of 24, compressed by a Perceiver resampler ( Jaegle et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ) .
A keypoint head additionally predicts where each part’s center of mass projects into the image, trained with a β \beta -NLL loss ( Seitzer et al., 2022 ) .
We drop the image for 10% of training examples and sample with classifier-free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) of strength 2, handing off to the pretrained model for the final steps ( t ≥ 0.85 t\geq 0.85 ).

blocks.en: 3.6 Connectivity Field
blocks.zh: 3.6 连接领域

blocks.en:
While large-scale pretraining teaches the model a useful global assembly prior, the learned flow does not explicitly enforce connector alignment.
Small positional errors or drifts can leave two parts misaligned, leading to an assembly where the predicted structure might be qualitatively close, but disconnected.
This is a natural failure mode for direct pose prediction in S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) N SE(3)^{N} : the set of connector-consistent configurations has measure zero in the full space.
To address this, we introduce a connectivity-field guidance, a scalar energy defined over joint pose whose gradient nudges estimates toward connected configurations.
We apply it at test time during sampling.
The field encodes the same constraints that define a valid connection, but as a soft energy: enforcing them as hard constraints would presuppose the connection graph, which is precisely what is inferred jointly with the poses.

这是在S E (3 ) N SE (3) QQN}中直接摆姿势预测的自然失效模式: 连接器-一致配置的一组在全空间中测量为零.
为了解决这个问题,我们引入了连接-场指导,一种在连带姿势上定义的平面能量,其梯度向连接的配置推移。

blocks.en: 4.2 Image-Conditioned Reconstruction

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 summarizes reconstruction quality across both evaluation sets.
Validity scales with model size: on BrickNet, unguided IC DiT-S/B/L reach 19.4%, 26.1%, and 30.5%, and guidance adds 4.6–5.6 points at every size.
PT models scale likewise on BrickNet, from 13.6% to 25.5% ( Tab. 5 ).
Image conditioning reduces pose error, lowering MM from 58.9 to 31.0 LDU on BrickNet (PT DiT-L to IC DiT-L).
ProcBrick follows the same trends at lower validity, as its assemblies are on average twice as large.
Finetuning on 50% or 25% of the renders lowers the BrickNet validity of IC DiT-S only moderately, from 19.4% to 18.1% and 16.2% ( App. G ).
Training IC DiT-S without the pretrained model, from random initialization and without the hand-off, lowers MM but increases the number of components and lowers BrickNet validity from 19.4% to 2.3% ( App. G ).
Pretraining provides structural priors that improve connectivity even when individual part poses are slightly less accurate.

blocks.en: 4.3 Connectivity and Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.3 连接和指导

blocks.en:
Without guidance, the number of components grows with part count ( Fig. 5 ).
Guidance reduces it at every part count, roughly halving it for the largest assemblies.
Guidance changes MM by at most 0.3 LDU ( Tab. 5 ).
Guided samples also have fewer colliding pairs than unguided ones for every model ( Tab. 1 ).
Validity nonetheless falls with part count, with or without guidance, to below 1% beyond about 50 parts for single samples and beyond 85 parts for the best of 100.
Large samples keep most parts in one component, but a single detached part or collision makes a sample invalid.

然而,单份样品的有效度随着部分计数(无论是否有指导)而降低到1%以下,超过约50个部分,超过85个部分则达到100个最佳部分。
大型样品将大部分部件保存在一个组件中,但单离子部件或碰撞使得样品无效.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
While the connectivity-field guidance improves connectivity substantially, it does not guarantee fully connected or physically valid assemblies.
The field has no explicit collision term, so it reduces collisions only indirectly, by pulling parts into seats.
Achieving full validity may require better test-time optimization, for example with explicit collision terms or a discrete search over possibilities.
blocks.zh:
虽然互联互通实地指导大大改进了互联互通,但并不保证充分连接或实际有效的组件。
球场没有明确的碰撞术语,因此只能通过将部分拉入座位来间接减少碰撞.
实现完全有效性可能需要更好的试验时间优化,例如,明确碰撞条件或对可能性进行离散搜索。

blocks.en:
While our synthetic data appears to cover the test distribution fairly well, the model struggles in dense builds where parts look alike ( Fig. 6 ).
We suspect performance is limited by the distribution gap.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的合成数据似乎很好地覆盖了测试分布,但模型在密集的构造中挣扎,其中的部件看起来相似(图6)。
我们怀疑业绩受到分配差距的限制。

blocks.en:
We assume that the inventory contains exactly the parts of the depicted assembly, and the method is not trained to handle missing, extra, or wrong parts.
Future work might consider how to handle this, but should consider more strongly the much more interesting problem of jointly inferring the object’s partset along with the poses of the parts.
To make the method applicable to images captured in-the-wild, where the partset is not already known, such as to digitize a LEGO collection, interested readers might look to how co-generation is done in protein-generation literature such as in Campbell et al. (2024) with mixed continuous–discrete denoising.
blocks.zh:
我们假设清单中包含的正是所描绘的组装的部分,而该方法没有经过训练来处理缺失,额外,或错误的部分.
今后的工作可以考虑如何处理这一问题,但应更有力地考虑更有趣的问题,即共同推断物体的部位及其部位。
要使这种方法适用于在不为人知的情况下捕获到的图像,例如将LEGO集数字化,有兴趣的读者不妨看看在蛋白质生成文献中如何进行共生,例如在Campbell等人(2024年),同时进行混合的连续-分解。

blocks.en:
Finally, while we train on assemblies of up to 100 parts, real-world LEGO sets can contain thousands.
Scaling to larger assemblies will require addressing both computational cost and the increased ambiguity of inferring large hidden substructures from a single view.
blocks.zh:
最后,当我们培训多达100个组件的组件时,现实世界的LEGO集可以包含数千个组件.
扩大到更大的组件将需要解决计算成本和从单一角度推断大型隐藏子结构的日益模糊性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Our work represents the first attempt to reconstruct a LEGO object given an image and its set of parts.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作是第一次尝试重建一个给一个图像及其一组部件的LEGO对象。

blocks.en:
To achieve this, we first trained a set-conditioned S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies (ProcBrick) to learn an adaptable assembly prior.
Second, we adapted this prior to single-image reconstruction using a fraction of the data, and despite training only on renders, demonstrated that the resulting model can produce plausible reconstructions of physical builds from photographs.
Finally, we introduced connectivity-field guidance, a test-time energy that pulls predictions toward connected assemblies during sampling, applicable without retraining, raising validity for every model at negligible pose cost and halving the number of disconnected components in large assemblies.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这一目标,我们首先在程序生成的组件(ProcBrick)上培训了一种设定条件的S E(3)SE(3)流式模型,以学习一个可适应的前置组件.
第二,我们利用一小部分数据在单一图像重建之前进行了调整,尽管只进行了有关事实的培训,但事实证明,由此产生的模型能够从照片中产生合理的物理建筑重建。
最后,我们引入了互联互通场指导,这是一种测试时间能量,在取样时对连接的组件进行预测,在不进行再培训的情况下适用,以可忽略不计的成本提高每个模型的有效性,并将大型组件中断开的组件数量减半。

blocks.en: Appendix H ProcBrick Details
blocks.zh: 附录H ProcBrick 细节

blocks.en:
Generation. A placement is rejected if two parts interpenetrate by more than 1 LDU, unless they are joined by a fixed connection.
Part-type frequencies are tilted toward larger parts and calibrated per connector family.
The seed part follows the occurrence frequencies of part types in human-designed models.
The acceptance test penalizes drops in packing density, and its targets for connector joins and connected neighbors per added part span roughly the median to the upper quantiles of human-designed models.
blocks.zh:
历代. 如果两个部分相互间超过1个LDU,则拒绝放置,除非它们被固定连接。
部分类型的频率向较大的部分倾斜,每个连接器家族都校准.
种子部分遵循人类设计模型中部分类型发生频率.
接受测试惩罚包装密度下降,其连接器的目标每增加一部分加入和连接邻居,大致跨度为人类设计模型上方的中位数。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Appearance and rendering. Each part’s material is one of 260 renderer materials, drawn by a policy fitted to the palettes of 53,431 human-designed models.
We render at 1024 × \times 1024 on a transparent background, lit by one of 964 environment maps or, for 10% of images, a studio setup.
During finetuning, we composite renders onto ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) or plain backgrounds and apply random camera roll, zoom, and offset, random erasing, photometric jitter, and sensor noise.
blocks.zh:
外观与渲染. 每一部分的材料是260种制作材料之一,由配有53,431个人类设计的调色板的政策绘制。
我们在1024x\times 1024 在一个透明的背景上,由964个环境地图之一点燃,或者,对于10%的图像,一个工作室设置。
在微调时,我们合成成成ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)或平版背景,并应用随机相机卷、缩放和抵消、随机擦除、光度测焦和传感器噪音。
